title: Hosted workspace bridge
responsibility: Connect project views, comments and permitted agent requests to the signed-in account on Web and native devices.

inputs.name: browserBridge.api
inputs.description: Authenticated project API port. Credentials remain in the browser session or native account layer.

outputs.name: browserBridge
outputs.description: A workspace bridge for project reads, comments and agent requests. Fresh server capabilities and the writable branch tip determine which actions are available. Refused reads notify listeners before failing.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects missing project IDs and denied requests. Project creation stays unavailable through this bridge; other server failures propagate.
